description: The pie chart illustrates the time distribution between two key phases in the Paper Copilot system: “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment.” The chart is divided into two segments, with the larger orange segment representing “Reduction,” which accounts for 60.9 seconds (69.92% of the total time), and the smaller blue segment representing “Efficient deployment,” which takes 26.2 seconds (30.08%). The “Reduction” slice is visually emphasized by being slightly separated (exploded) from the rest of the pie, drawing attention to its dominant share. Both segments are labeled with their respective time values and percentages, and the chart uses a simple two-color scheme (orange and blue) with clear, legible text for easy interpretation. This visualization highlights that the majority of processing time in the system is spent on the reduction phase, while efficient deployment constitutes a smaller but still significant portion.
